import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import pytest
from pandas.io.formats import excel
from pandas.util.testing import assert_frame_equal, assert_index_equal

@pytest.fixture
def simple_xlsx():
    xlsx = excel.ExcelWriter('simple.xlsx')
    yield xlsx
    xlsx.close()


def test_init_write(simple_xlsx):
    df = pd.DataFrame([[1, 2], [3, 4]], columns=['a', 'b'])
    df.to_excel(simple_xlsx, index=False, sheet_name='test')
    simple_xlsx.save()

    df2 = pd.read_excel('simple.xlsx')
    assert_frame_equal(df, df2)

def test_simple(simple_xlsx):
    df = pd.DataFrame([[1, 2], [3, 4]], columns=['a', 'b'])
    df.to_excel(simple_xlsx, index=False, sheet_name='test')
    simple_xlsx.save()

    df2 = pd.read_excel('simple.xlsx')
    assert_frame_equal(df, df2)
